_doc: The topic list. Topics and subtopics follow how research communities divide the field. id: slug of the name. name: sidebar label (about 36 characters at most, the field's own term, one concept, with a second after "&" only if it would not be expected under the first; no lists or punctuation; American spelling; "Quantum" left out of topic names and kept in subtopics only where it is part of the term). definition: hover text, a short scope list (about 126 characters at most). search_terms: extra terms "Find a topic" matches, not shown. rules.keywords: regex over title, OpenAlex keywords and concepts that seeds the subtopic. clusters: clusters in data/topics/discovery.json that correspond to the subtopic. area_clusters: the broader clusters its papers fall in.
